findings.title: validation receipt absence summary is incomplete
findings.evidence: trust_chain/validation_receipt.json expected_absence lists 7 aggregate names, while external_input_register.json enumerates 11 distinct absent inputs
findings.impact: intermediate_chain, leaf_attestor, signature_profile, signed_receipt, source_version_binding, and independent_attestation_scope are not individually represented in the receipt absence ledger; a future checker could incorrectly treat the absence closure as complete
findings.required_action: replace aggregate expected_absence entries with the exact 11 input IDs or provide an explicit lossless mapping to every register ID; preserve typed_absence and no_publish

findings.title: no canonical fingerprint is frozen for the unchanged-input rule
findings.evidence: manifest and external_input_register state that a new attempt requires a changed canonical input fingerprint, but neither records a current register/contract fingerprint or a deterministic fingerprint recipe over the 11 absence records
findings.impact: the no-repeat/no-synonymous-AD rule cannot be mechanically evaluated from this package; an operator could claim a change without an auditable before/after fingerprint
findings.required_action: record a deterministic canonical fingerprint of the complete typed-absence register plus contract/profile versions, and require a changed fingerprint before any retry

findings.title: revocation unavailable disposition is semantically ambiguous
findings.evidence: trust_path_requirements.json path_validation.fail_closed_on includes unavailable revocation, while revocation_time_replay_contract.json distinguishes revoked/expired/unknown as fail_closed from unavailable as revocation_status_unavailable typed_absence_terminal_deferred
findings.impact: an implementation may emit the wrong typed status or treat unavailable as a certificate contradiction; the contract requires distinct fail_closed versus typed_absence_terminal_deferred semantics even though both prohibit publish
findings.required_action: state the exact error/status mapping: unavailable or untrusted external service => revocation_status_unavailable + typed_absence + terminal_deferred + no_publish; revoked/expired/invalid response => fail_closed

findings.title: validation order does not explicitly lead with canonical digest and scope binding
findings.evidence: trust_path_requirements.path_order starts at root and lists receipt_signature later, while contract.md requires canonical bytes/digest and source/scope/replay structure checks before path construction
findings.impact: the list is not a complete executable order and could permit path work before rejecting a mutated or foreign receipt
findings.required_action: make canonical schema/bytes/digest, source-version/scope, and replay-field structure explicit as stages 0-1 before root/intermediate/leaf validation

findings.title: source-version binding lacks a lossless owner inventory
findings.evidence: external_input_register source_version_binding describes six HEAD owners and three AD56 dirty executors but does not enumerate their paths, expected hashes/OIDs, or the exact HEAD-versus-working-tree distinction
findings.impact: future signed receipts cannot be checked against a machine-readable owner set without importing an unstated external document; dirty executor substitution could be missed
findings.required_action: bind the exact six owner paths and three factory paths to canonical HEAD blob/OID and dirty-working-tree hashes, with explicit source locator and version fields

findings.title: algorithm and policy identity remain placeholders rather than bounded policy
findings.evidence: leaf EKU uses project_attestation_signing_oid and signature_profile is typed_absent; no allowed algorithm/key-strength/encoding set or immutable policy OID value is present
findings.impact: future verifier could accept an algorithm or policy that is merely syntactically present but not authorized by a concrete profile
findings.required_action: supply a versioned profile with exact allowed algorithms, key sizes, signature encoding, canonicalization, EKU OID, policy OID, and retirement rules; until then retain typed_absence

findings.title: authority decision field is not constrained to a typed decision vocabulary
findings.evidence: witness_authority/authority_channel_contract.json ack_schema uses a placeholder authority_decision string and does not define allowed values or a no-authority state machine
findings.impact: a future channel package could return an unrecognized decision token that is accidentally treated as acceptance
findings.required_action: define a closed enum with unknown/unavailable/rejected/accepted_for_declared_scope and require unknown to be fail_closed

positive_checks: all seven trust_chain files exist and JSON parses with unique keys
exact seven-file set matches manifest outputs and cleanup owned_products
root/intermediate/leaf EKU, keyUsage, basicConstraints, nameConstraints and policy checks are named
CRL/OCSP freshness, trusted RFC3161 time, nonce/challenge/sequence/idempotency/replay and rotation are explicitly named
typed_absence responsibility and recovery fields are present in external_input_register
no key/certificate/production trust material was generated
39-node DAG, R01-R10, T0/T1/T2, B00/B04 and L4 boundaries remain open
